summary_1line: Kasyapa asks how the soul leaves the body, gains another, and attains liberation; the sage begins explaining death as the body’s elements and vital breaths collapse.

image_candidates.scene_text: An aged sage sits before Kasyapa while explaining how the inner wind and heat surge through the body as the soul prepares to leave.
Invisible vital winds rush upward through a human body as glowing heat pierces the vital points and the soul slips out in pain.
A suffering soul exits a collapsing body as the five elements of the body dissolve back into earth, water, fire, air, and space.
